theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtsr_face_count_induction
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ a : Euclid P, (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∀ Ψ : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ x, Ψ (m + 1) x = x) → (∀ j, m + 2 ≤ j → j ≤ P → ∀ (b : Fin P → ℤ) (J : Finset (Fin P)) (hJ : J.Nonempty), J.card = j → ∀ x : Euclid P, (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → x i = b i)) → ∀ y : Euclid P, (∀ i, y i = if i ∈ J then (b i : ℝ) + a i + (x i - b i - a i) / J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k)) else x i) → Ψ j x = Ψ (j - 1) y) → ∀ j, m + 2 ≤ j → j ≤ P → ∀ (b : Fin P → ℤ) (J : Finset (Fin P)), J.card = j → ∀ x : Euclid P, (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → x i = b i)) → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (J.filter (fun i => |x i - b i - a i| < ρ)).card ≤ m + 1 → (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ Ψ j x i ∧ Ψ j x i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → Ψ j x i = b i)) ∧ (∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, Ψ j x i = z) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[{w : Euclid P | ∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ w i ∧ w i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → w i = b i)}] x, dist (Ψ j y) (Ψ j x) ≤ c / ρ * dist y x
